result_json.summary: Phase 2's scope-intersection validation and paired receipt logic are sound and well tested at the pure-function level. However, the amend handler resolves the reviewer's review-doc commit as the approved plan commit, so real registrations fail. The CAS precondition is built from history read after validation, registration bypasses shared finalization so a retry never projects the step locally, and the handler has no tests.

items.title: amend resolves the reviewer's review-doc commit as the approved plan commit, so real registrations always fail
items.reason: amendImplementationPlanCommand uses the last git:commit before the approval step as approvedPlanCommit and boundaryCommit. reviewer-plan.md requires the plan reviewer to 5x commit its review doc before the verdict is recorded, so that commit is the review commit, and the author-commit check rejects it. Full file-qualified hunk evidence (review-decision.handler.ts @@ -1232,6 +1262,259 @@, range 490f6f1061f9ec38aeb93df877df74d3ccbe9877..ba5ead07d954440596de147028c7aef8d3c0ee38) is in the emitted verdict.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Mirror implementation-recovery.handler.ts:96-153. Take approvedPlanCommit from the completed plan author step's result.commit, and keep the last git:commit as the review boundary. Check ancestry, plan-byte equality and excluded-path equivalence, and pass the two commits separately.
items.failure: Every orchestrated amendment review (author commit, then reviewer 5x commit, then verdict) is rejected with 'The approved plan commit must be the completed author commit at the review boundary.' If that check were relaxed, the receipt would record the review commit as the approved plan commit.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Resolve the approved commit from the author step between the human and approval steps. Validate the boundary git:commit as a descendant with identical plan bytes and only excluded-path changes, then add a handler test with a reviewer git:commit.

items.title: CAS expectedKeys for budget/decisions are read at append time, not from the validated snapshot
items.reason: registerImplementationAmendment validates against budget and decision reads taken early, but builds the budget and decisions expectedKeys from fresh reads inside the atomicAppendIfAllNew call. A concurrent budget-only append in between, such as a recover-plan receipt, passes the precondition. Decision 7 and the Phase 2 gate forbid this. Hunk evidence: implementation-amendment.ts @@ -1456,3 +1479,1314 @@.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Snapshot the steps, budget and decisions keys once before the first validation read, and pass those arrays as expectedKeys, as implementation-recovery.ts:433-437 does.
items.failure: A recover-plan receipt or another budget-only line appended after validation but before the append is folded into expectedKeys. The amendment then appends on the same predecessor, forking the lineage, and the fold fails closed for the run.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Capture all three key lists at the start of registration and reuse them. Add a test that injects a budget-only append between validation and append.

items.title: Registration bypasses shared admission/finalization; retry after partial local projection never projects the step
items.reason: Phase 2 requires the receipt and record to be paired through shared admission/finalization, plus a retry-after-partial-local-projection test. The command appends directly and calls recordStep only when result.created is true. It also skips the admission, ensureRunRecord, redaction and duplicate-path projection that finalizeAndWritePreparedStep provides. Hunk evidence: review-decision.handler.ts @@ -1232,6 +1262,259 @@.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Use prepareRecordStepAppend and finalizeAndWritePreparedStep in paired-all-new mode with the budget receipt as extraOps, extending the seam to forward expectedKeys. At minimum, project the durable step line on both the created and winner paths (recordStep is INSERT OR IGNORE).
items.failure: If the process dies after the journal pair is durable but before the SQLite recordStep runs, every retry returns created:false. The implementation:amendment row is never projected into the local index.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Project the durable step on both the created and idempotent-winner paths, route the write through the shared finalization seam, and add a test for partial local projection.

items.title: The review implementation amend handler/CLI has no tests
items.reason: No test calls amendImplementationPlanCommand or the amend CLI. Several things are untested: the git boundary resolution, plan-at-commit and ancestry checks, the clean-worktree and excluded-path checks, the resolveJournalStep selectors (numeric, run-qualified, cross-run), the unresolvedApprovalGate mode handling, and the SQLite projection. The plan's stale plan/head and missing-authorization tests run only against the pure function, with headAccepted passed in.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Add handler tests using the git fixture pattern in test/unit/commands/implementation-recovery.test.ts.
items.failure: The handler's boundary-commit defect (P1.1) shipped undetected, and so would regressions in selector resolution or head and worktree validation.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Add handler tests for: dry-run and record through author commit, reviewer git:commit and verdict; a code change after approval; a dirty plan; numeric and run-qualified selectors; a foreign-run key; and an identical retry.

items.title: Registration pendingFindings bypasses the canonical effective finding register
items.reason: pendingFindings lists every item of every observation on the binding, minus the new resolutions. That includes findings later rounds closed and observations invalidated by earlier revisions. Decisions 6 and 8 require the one canonical register, which the fold already exposes as findings.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Derive pendingFindings from folded.findings with status pending, excluding the assessment's resolvedFindings.
items.failure: Dry-run and registration output report findings that were already fixed in code as retained pending findings, which misleads the operator about the work remaining.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Replace the raw observation scan with a filter over folded.findings.

items.title: Identical review decide retry fails after its amendment registers
items.reason: acceptStoredImplementationDecision rebuilds amendmentScope through recordedAmendmentScope, which requires the predecessor to be the current revision. After registration the revision has advanced, so an identical retry of the decision is rejected instead of returning the stored decision.
items.mechanicalExplanation: On the stored-decision path, compare the supplied scope with the stored amendmentScope, with fingerprints filled from the observations, and skip the current-predecessor check.
items.failure: Re-running the same 5x review decide authorize_amendment command after amend fails with REVIEW_DECISION_INVALID 'predecessor ... is not the current revision'.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Validate the retry's scope against the stored decision rather than against current state.

introducedBy.explanation: The stored-decision acceptance path now recomputes amendmentScope against the current revision.

items.reason: bun run lint reports 7 fixable useOptionalChain warnings, all in the new registration code.
items.mechanicalExplanation: Apply Biome's fixable optional-chain rewrite at lines 1570, 2007, 2062, 2087, 2106, 2177 and 2356.
items.failure: Lint output is no longer clean, which hides real warnings in later phases.
